The message was dated thirty years earlier: “If this reaches you, tell my sister the lighthouse still shines.” Beneath the words was a name and an address from a nearby village. At dawn, he walked there. An elderly woman answered the door, and when she read the note, her hands trembled. Her brother had vanished at sea before she was grown. That evening, the keeper lit the lamp with a little more care.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有完全醒来。高楼的窗户大多暗着，街灯把湿润的路面照成淡淡的金色。远处传来清洁车缓慢的声响，几家早餐店升起白色蒸汽。公交车空荡荡地驶过路口，红灯映在车窗上，像一枚安静的印章。便利店门口，夜班的人捧着热咖啡，望着天边渐渐变浅的蓝。树叶间偶尔响起鸟鸣，提醒沉睡的街道：新的一天已经悄悄开始。","w03":"- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: each box holds a smaller box, until you reach the last one with a toy.\n- A recursive solution needs a stopping point, so it knows when to stop making smaller boxes."}
